Read the table of contents, the whole of 1.2 Main findings (Chapter 2 summary on page 11), the Cluster 2 introduction and the full Chapter 2 section (pages 62-63), and screened every other section with technology keywords. The Chapter 2 section itself carries no preparation or progress rating in this report; the rating is in the main findings. Text-file page numbers are printed page numbers plus one.
